name: DOTA: A Large-Scale Dataset for Object Detection in Aerial Images
description: A benchmark dataset for oriented and horizontal object detection in earth observation and aerial images, curated by Wuhan University and Huazhong University of Science and Technology. Contains 2,806 high-resolution aerial images collected from multiple airborne sensors and satellite platforms (including Google Earth and JL-1). Features 188,282 oriented bounding box instances across 15 common categories (planes, ships, storage tanks, harbors, bridges, vehicles), labeled by aerial image interpretation experts.
